svg.desc: Every wiki image by producer, with size and the number of pages that show it
svg.text: Figure 1 · Every image and what writes it
75 images: 56 generated from the records, 13 rendered stills, 6 exported by hand from draw.io. The number is how many pages show the image; 3 are shown by none.

Generated by tools/figures/wikiimages_readme.py from the images in docs/wiki/images, the producer map of docs_readme.py and every page that shows them. Figures show records and synthetic results; nothing in them is verified or

g.text: Terms: KB = kilobyte, a file size of 1,024 bytes · R01 … = validator rule in tools/pdac (R13 = only a named human review accepts anything)
